recipe_id: 11 Moussaka with Potato, Eggplant, Beef and Béchamel
source_text:
Recipe text:  
1. 将 Graviera 奶酪切碎，取出备用。
2. 洋葱、大蒜、橄榄油、番茄膏、肉桂和糖一起切碎并煸炒。
3. 加入牛肉末、月桂叶和多香果继续煸炒。
4. 加入干红葡萄酒继续炒制。
5. 加入罐装碎番茄、水、盐和黑胡椒，混合均匀并继续烹煮成肉酱。与此同时，将土豆片和茄子片分别加盐和少量橄榄油蒸熟，之后取出沥干备用。 Xiachufang
6. 将牛奶、面粉、黄油、鸡蛋、盐和肉豆蔻一起加热熬煮，制成 Béchamel 白酱，同时将烤箱预热至 200°C。 Xiachufang
7. 烤盘底部先铺土豆片，撒一部分奶酪；再铺一半茄子片，加入全部肉酱，然后铺上剩余茄子片。
8. 倒入全部 Béchamel 白酱，表面撒上剩余奶酪。
9. 放入预热至 200°C 的烤箱烘烤约 60 分钟，出炉后切块食用。

text_steps.text_en: Shred the Graviera cheese.

text_steps.text: 洋葱、大蒜、橄榄油、番茄膏、肉桂和糖一起切碎
text_steps.text_en: Combine the garlic with the onion, olive oil, tomato paste, cinnamon and sugar for chopping together.

text_steps.text: 洋葱、大蒜、橄榄油、番茄膏、肉桂和糖一起切碎
text_steps.text_en: Combine the olive oil with the onion, garlic, tomato paste, cinnamon and sugar for chopping together.

text_steps.text: 洋葱、大蒜、橄榄油、番茄膏、肉桂和糖一起切碎
text_steps.text_en: Combine the tomato paste with the onion, garlic, olive oil, cinnamon and sugar for chopping together.

text_steps.text: 洋葱、大蒜、橄榄油、番茄膏、肉桂和糖一起切碎
text_steps.text_en: Combine the cinnamon with the onion, garlic, olive oil, tomato paste and sugar for chopping together.

text_steps.text: 洋葱、大蒜、橄榄油、番茄膏、肉桂和糖一起切碎
text_steps.text_en: Combine the sugar with the onion, garlic, olive oil, tomato paste and cinnamon for chopping together.

text_steps.text: 洋葱、大蒜、橄榄油、番茄膏、肉桂和糖一起切碎
text_steps.text_en: Chop the onion, garlic, olive oil, tomato paste, cinnamon and sugar together.
Stir-fry the chopped mixture.
Add the ground beef.
Add the bay leaf along with the ground beef.

text_steps.text: 加入牛肉末、月桂叶和多香果
text_steps.text_en: Add the allspice along with the ground beef and bay leaf.
Continue stir-frying.
Add the dry red wine.
Continue frying.
Add the canned crushed tomatoes.
Add water with the canned crushed tomatoes.
Add salt with the canned crushed tomatoes and water.

text_steps.text: 加入罐装碎番茄、水、盐和黑胡椒
text_steps.text_en: Add black pepper with the canned crushed tomatoes, water and salt.
Mix evenly.
Continue cooking until it becomes meat sauce.

text_steps.text: 将土豆片和茄子片分别加盐
text_steps.text_en: Season the potato slices separately with salt.

text_steps.text: 将土豆片和茄子片分别加盐和少量橄榄油
text_steps.text_en: Add a little olive oil to the potato slices separately.

text_steps.text: 将土豆片和茄子片分别加盐和少量橄榄油蒸熟
text_steps.text_en: Steam the seasoned potato slices separately until cooked.
Remove the cooked potato slices, drain them and set them aside.

text_steps.text: 将土豆片和茄子片分别加盐
text_steps.text_en: Season the eggplant slices separately with salt.

text_steps.text: 将土豆片和茄子片分别加盐和少量橄榄油
text_steps.text_en: Add a little olive oil to the eggplant slices separately.

text_steps.text: 将土豆片和茄子片分别加盐和少量橄榄油蒸熟
text_steps.text_en: Steam the seasoned eggplant slices separately until cooked.
Remove the cooked eggplant slices, drain them and set them aside.
Combine the flour with the milk.
Combine the butter with the milk and flour.
Combine the egg with the milk, flour and butter.

text_steps.text: 将牛奶、面粉、黄油、鸡蛋、盐
text_steps.text_en: Combine the salt with the milk, flour, butter and egg.

text_steps.text: 将牛奶、面粉、黄油、鸡蛋、盐和肉豆蔻
text_steps.text_en: Combine the nutmeg with the milk, flour, butter, egg and salt.

text_steps.text: 将牛奶、面粉、黄油、鸡蛋、盐和肉豆蔻一起加热
text_steps.text_en: Heat the milk, flour, butter, egg, salt and nutmeg together.

text_steps.text: 熬煮，制成 Béchamel 白酱
text_steps.text_en: Cook the mixture until it forms Béchamel white sauce.
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 200°C.
First lay the potato slices across the bottom of the baking dish.
Sprinkle on a portion of the cheese.
Use half of the eggplant slices for the next layer, leaving the rest for later.
Next, layer on half of the eggplant slices.
Add all of the meat sauce.
Then layer on the remaining eggplant slices.

text_steps.text: 倒入全部 Béchamel 白酱
text_steps.text_en: Pour on all of the Béchamel white sauce.
Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the surface.

text_steps.text: 放入预热至 200°C 的烤箱烘烤约 60 分钟
text_steps.text_en: Place it in the oven preheated to 200°C and bake for about 60 minutes.
After removing it from the oven, cut it into pieces to serve.
